    • pickupWithBackup

      public static edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command pickupWithBackup(Drivetrain drivetrain, Arm arm, Shooter shooter, int pos, int backupPos)
      Makes a command to pick up a game piece. If it is not successful, it will attempt to pick up another game piece
      Parameters:
      drivetrain - The drivetrain
      arm - The arm
      shooter - The shooter
      pos - The game piece index
      backupPos - The game piece index to pick up if the first fails
      Returns:
      A command that drives to the game piece and attempts to intake it. If it fails, it will attempt to pick up the second game piece
